# ChatGPT Ads Multi-Agent System

> Universal AI knowledge base and operating skill pack for ChatGPT Ads research, planning, creative generation, measurement, and guarded automation across Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.

- Author: Mamdouh Aboammar (https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar)
- Repository: https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/chatgpt-ads
- Version: 0.4.0
- License: MIT

## Core Overview
ChatGPT Ads is an independent, MIT-licensed knowledge and operating engine designed for AI agents and developers building automated, privacy-preserving advertising workflows on ChatGPT. It adheres to strict fail-closed security invariants, POSIX descriptor-backed path traversal (O_NOFOLLOW), and deterministic evidence tracking.

## Architecture & Skill Manifests
- [Main Skill Orchestrator](SKILL.md): Master router dispatching across 12 domain skills.
- [OpenAI Codex Plugin Manifest](.codex-plugin/plugin.json): Configuration for OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT developer sessions.
- [Claude Marketplace Manifest](marketplace.json): Plugin schema specification for Claude Desktop and Claude Code.
- [Skills.sh Registry Manifest](.skills.json): Hub listing enabling `npx skills add imMamdouhaboammar/chatgpt-ads`.
- [Knowledge Brain Index](brain/index.md): Sourced facts, claims, and verified citations.

## The 12 Domain Skills
1. `chatgpt-ads`: Orchestrator and workflow router.
2. `chatgpt-ads-research`: Sourced platform evidence verification and ledger queries.
3. `chatgpt-ads-readiness`: Client eligibility, ad policy prerequisites, and account setup.
4. `chatgpt-ads-plan`: Campaign strategy, pacing budgets, and unit economics.
5. `chatgpt-ads-creative`: Ad copy briefs, multi-modal prompt variations, and compliance.
6. `chatgpt-ads-measurement`: Attribution modeling, conversion tracking, and tracking integrity.
7. `chatgpt-ads-analyze`: Performance diagnostics, funnel degradation, and anomaly analysis.
8. `chatgpt-ads-experiment`: Geo-lift and A/B split testing methodology.
9. `chatgpt-ads-policy`: Advertising guidelines and regulatory constraints.
10. `chatgpt-ads-launch`: Staged change validation and batch verification.
11. `chatgpt-ads-operate`: Guarded account operations with local checkpoint locks.
12. `chatgpt-ads-monitor`: Pacing alerts, drift monitoring, and anomaly detection.

## CLI & Runtime Invariants
- Safe I/O: POSIX descriptor-backed no-follow traversal, Darwin root alias normalization.
- Zero credential leakage: Scanned against secret patterns before public release.
- Bounded local queries: `python3 -m chatgpt_ads_brain query "<question>"`.
